article.title: Why a Meeting Needs One Clear Owner
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
A meeting can feel successful even when nothing happens afterward. People may agree with the plan, smile, and leave the room with a positive feeling. But a few days later, the team may discover that an important task is still unfinished. One common reason is simple: nobody clearly owned the next step.

A clear owner is one person who is responsible for making sure an action moves forward. The owner does not need to do every part of the work alone. Other people can help, provide data, review a document, or make a decision. However, one person should know that the team expects him or her to follow the action until it is completed or handed over.

Imagine that a team discusses a customer problem. Everyone agrees that the company should check the recent data. If the meeting note only says, 'Check the data next week,' each person may think someone else will do it. A better note says, 'Mika will check the customer data and share the result by Tuesday.' Now the owner, task, and deadline are clear.

This practice also makes follow-up easier. At the next meeting, the team does not need to ask, 'Who was doing this?' They can ask about the result and decide what to do next. If the owner has a problem, the team can help earlier instead of discovering the delay at the last minute.

Clear ownership is not about blaming one person. It is about reducing confusion. Good teams still work together, but they make responsibility visible. A short meeting note with an owner and a deadline can save many messages later. Before ending a meeting, ask three simple questions: What is the next action? Who owns it? When should it be done? These questions turn discussion into execution.
paragraphs.zh: 會議氣氛良好並不代表事情之後真的會發生。明確的 owner 是負責確保某項行動持續往前的人，他不需要獨自完成所有工作，但必須知道團隊期待他追蹤到完成或正式交接。會議紀錄若只寫『下週確認資料』，每個人都可能以為別人會做；寫成『Mika 週二前確認客戶資料並分享結果』，責任、任務與期限就清楚了。明確 ownership 不是為了責怪，而是降低混亂。會議結束前確認下一步、owner 與 deadline，可以把討論真正轉成執行。
paragraphs.ja: 会議がうまく進んだように見えても、その後に何も起きないことがあります。明確なownerとは、アクションが前に進むことを確認する責任者です。すべてを一人で行う必要はありませんが、完了または正式な引き継ぎまで追う人を一人決めます。議事録に『来週データを確認する』だけでは誰も動かない可能性があります。『Mikaが火曜日までに顧客データを確認して共有する』なら、担当・作業・期限が明確です。ownershipは責任追及ではなく混乱を減らす仕組みです。会議の最後に次の行動、owner、deadlineを確認すると、議論を実行へ変えられます。

vocabulary.usage: One clear owner follows the action.
She is responsible for the next step.
The task can be handed over.

phrases.example: The action needs to move forward.

grammar.title: make + object + adjective
grammar.body: 例如 make responsibility visible，表示使某事變得……。

business.example: Before we close, who owns this action?
What is the deadline for this task?

quiz.question: Why does a task need one clear owner?
quiz.answer: To reduce confusion and make sure it moves forward.

quiz.question: Output: Give an owner and deadline for one task.
quiz.answer: Example: I will send the report by Friday.
